horoscopes.intro: November 9 in the stars: Find out what’s in store for you today in our daily horoscopes for Monday November 9. Read the daily horoscopes for your Sun sign or rising sign (ascendant) to plan your day.

aries.text: If your momentum has stalled lately, today’s new moon in Scorpio supercharges your eighth house AND your seductive powers. Grab hold of anything that feels past its expiration date and breathe new life into it. This lunation is about transformation, so adopt a selective policy: leave the energy vampires and fair-weather friends behind, and spend your time with people who make you feel magnetic. Beauty and self-worth are intrinsically connected now. If you’ve been tempted to switch up your aesthetic or reclaim your confidence in the bedroom, this moon practically dares you to fan those flames.

taurus.text: Today’s new moon in Scorpio, the year’s only one, imbues your partnerships with a more serious glow. This lunation reignites your desires and your willingness to go after them, but it comes with a warning label. Real trust doesn’t form overnight, even when the chemistry with someone new feels instant. Your judgment gets supercharged, and people you’d normally let pass by unnoticed might suddenly capture your attention. In an LTR? You may feel ready to take a major leap, whether that’s swapping keys or exchanging rings. Big trust moves require patience, so build on every level.

gemini.text: We can’t blame you if you want to sample every holiday cookie being passed around, Gemini. Today’s new moon in Scorpio activates your sixth house of health, so make sure you start your meals with greens and protein, too. Book the massages and Pilates sessions, and carve out adequate sleep time. Building sustainable habits takes patience during a season of excess, but this lunar reset will inspire you to work smarter instead of harder. Job hunting? Refresh your resume and LinkedIn presence now, since recruiters might reach out. Then launch a decluttering project that spans the physical and digital realms: shred old papers and clean out your inbox.

cancer.text: Every Cancer values being seen and appreciated for their abilities. Today’s new moon in Scorpio, the only one of the year, energizes your fifth house of passion, creativity and romance, boosting both your visibility and your financial potential. You might need to invest in your own development, perhaps by taking a specialized course or getting professional photos taken. Because the fifth house rewards bold moves, a calculated risk or a new romantic connection could deliver a major win. Money and love get tangled in the weeks ahead, so set clear terms early to protect your equilibrium.

leo.text: Embrace hibernation mode, Leo. You’ll cherish whatever quiet time you can capture today, when the annual new moon in Scorpio lights up your fourth house of home and sanctuary. Focus on elevating your living space: declutter, reorganize and inject some fresh energy. Maybe you’ll finally tackle that renovation or invest in furniture that makes everything feel more welcoming. Buying property? Your foundation needs attention now, whether you’re moving or staying put. Before knocking down walls or choosing paint colors, clarify exactly what you want from your space, and resist any pressure to rush a major decision.

virgo.text: Today’s new moon in Scorpio, the only one of the year, activates your chatty third house. No matter how much someone talks up an event or a luxury product, stay skeptical. There’s no reason to rush into a major commitment or purchase right now, and your flexible, mutable nature will thank you for keeping your options open. Thinking of buying a car or a major appliance? Hold off until Mercury clears its retrograde cycle on Friday, but do start pricing them out. Meanwhile, your immediate surroundings are buzzing with potential. Strike up conversations with business owners in your area, since they might trigger brilliant inspiration.

libra.text: Today’s Scorpio new moon lands in your second house of income and resources, offering a genuine chance to reset your relationship with money. Struggling with debt? You can map out a practical strategy to improve your cash flow. Resist the urge to splurge on haute items right now, Libra, but relax: tightening things up temporarily doesn’t mean permanent deprivation. Dedicate a few hours to poring over every bank account and credit card statement. Since budgets have two sides, spend the coming month focused on the earning one. Refresh your professional materials and alert your network.

scorpio.text: Toast to new beginnings today! The new moon in Scorpio, the only one of 2026, launches your personal New Year celebration. This couldn’t be a better moment for clarifying your top goals and charting a path toward everything you want to achieve. The energy is electric right now, so carve out a chunk of uninterrupted alone time. Capture your dreams on paper or assemble a collage using images that speak to your soul, and don’t analyze or edit yourself. Think of this as planting seeds rather than forcing blooms, and avoid locking into rigid commitments.

sagittarius.text: Today features the only Scorpio new moon of the year, landing in your ethereal twelfth house and offering a rare chance to wipe clean at least one slate. Put pragmatic concerns aside, and if you have specific aspirations for the months ahead, write them out and sit with them. The twelfth house rules letting go, forgiveness and spiritual completion, so release whatever no longer serves your highest good. You don’t necessarily need to break up with anyone, but you CAN let go of old grudges and tired narratives. Try “live and let live” as your new philosophy.

capricorn.text: Today’s Scorpio new moon, the only one of the year, activates your “all for one and one for all” zone of teams and collective dreams. As someone comfortable taking charge, you don’t shy away from claiming your due credit and chasing glory. But think how much more satisfying life might be if you could co-create with a dream team. Stop hoarding every task and accept help from talented, trustworthy people. Open up to your friend group about your goals, and you might be blown away by how many people want to support your vision.

aquarius.text: Ready for liftoff, Aquarius? Today’s annual new moon in Scorpio energizes your ambitious tenth house of career and public recognition, launching a six-month window that could catapult your professional reputation. The clearer you are about your goals, the more your results will reflect them, so reverse engineer from your ideal outcome. Rather than grinding endlessly and hoping for the best, strategic relationship-building will accelerate your trajectory. Your social network can open doors faster than years of solitary effort, so consider investing in power breakfasts with industry leaders or enrolling in that specialized workshop.

pisces.text: Today’s new moon in Scorpio turns up the heat in your ninth house of expansion, higher learning and distant horizons. Opportunities that align with your true calling might require a bit more travel than you expected, Pisces. Feed your wanderlust by researching destinations and sketching out preliminary itineraries, even if departure is months away. Tight on cash? Get resourceful and explore home exchanges or splitting accommodation costs with friends. The ninth house also governs entrepreneurship, so this cycle supports laying the groundwork for a venture where you’re the boss.
